kept.title_or_quote: Ask HN: Know of any good server uptime monitoring tools?
kept.why_relevant: Someone is directly asking HN for uptime monitoring tool recommendations.

rescore.why: The thread author is explicitly asking for server uptime monitoring tools, which is exactly what this app provides.

kept.drafted_reply: Nagios and Munin are solid classics but require self-hosting and config management overhead. If you want something hosted that checks HTTP, TCP, and cron jobs every 30 seconds without clicking through a UI, a REST API lets you script monitor setup the same way you'd configure your server. The RSS/JSON update delivery you mentioned maps well to webhook alerts that can feed whatever client format you need. I built pingdeck for this use case — API-first uptime monitoring with status pages included — if you want to compare it against the self-hosted options: {APP_URL}.
